as_told.title: Scientology's belief in a Pleiadian-versus-reptilian conflict

plain: A lawyer and researcher named Dan Sheehan says on a podcast that followers of Scientology, a religious movement, believe a great conflict is under way. In his telling, it pits humanlike beings from the Pleiades, a cluster of stars, against reptilian beings from Zeta Reticuli, another star system, with Earth caught up in it.
